sql:
SELECT P.ID, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INT) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, Date
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT >= 52
) L ON P.ID = L.ID
GROUP BY P.ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT L.Date) > 2
